integrity: An exact rational polynomial and Bernstein positivity certificate proves the global minimax statement; independent floating Gram construction is corroborative. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact degree four on the unit two-sphere; a single equally sampled latitude circle of N >= 9 samples; equal sample weights; no claim of global optimality over arbitrary spherical point sets, multiring geometry, or full degree-at-most-four sampling.
title: A sharp latitude for exact quartic spherical-harmonic recovery from one regular polygon
